sentences.en: For instance, many people enjoy reading books on their free time.
sentences.zh: 例如，很多人喜欢在空闲时间读书。

sentences.en: When choosing a pet, for instances cats are low maintenance and great companions.
sentences.zh: 比如，在选择宠物时，猫是一种低维护且很好的伴侣。

sentences.en: For instance, last weekend we went camping; it was really fun but also tiring.
sentences.zh: 例如，上个周末我们去野营了；那真是既有趣又累。
